"""design_E6D6 모델링 준비: 코호트·특성·라벨·분할만 만든다 (학습/평가 없음)."""
import json, pathlib
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import GroupShuffleSplit

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
D, OUT = ROOT / "data", ROOT / "prep"
design = json.loads((ROOT / "design_E6D6.json").read_text())

p = pd.read_csv(D / "patients.csv.gz")
a = pd.read_csv(D / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
dx = pd.read_csv(D / "diagnoses.csv.gz")
labs = pd.read_csv(D / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["report_time"])
orders = pd.read_csv(D / "orders.csv.gz", parse_dates=["order_time"])

# --- 결과: 퇴원(tp) 후 30일 안에 다음 입원 시작
a = a.sort_values(["patient_id", "admit_time"]).reset_index(drop=True)
a["tp"] = a["discharge_time"]
a["next_admit"] = a.groupby("patient_id")["admit_time"].shift(-1)
a["readmit_30d"] = ((a.next_admit > a.tp) & (a.next_admit <= a.tp + pd.Timedelta(days=30))).astype(int)
data_end = a[["admit_time", "discharge_time"]].max().max()
a["followup_complete"] = (a.tp + pd.Timedelta(days=30)) <= data_end

# --- 코호트
c = a.merge(p, on="patient_id", how="left")
c = c[c.age >= 18]
c = c[c.discharge_status != "died"].copy()

# --- 특성
def win(df, tcol):
    m = df.merge(c[["admission_id", "admit_time", "tp"]], on="admission_id")
    return m[(m[tcol] >= m.admit_time) & (m[tcol] <= m.tp)]

L = win(labs, "report_time").sort_values("report_time")
cr = L[L.test == "creatinine"].groupby("admission_id")["value"].last().rename("cr_last")
hgb = L[L.test == "hemoglobin"].groupby("admission_id")["value"].min().rename("hgb_min")
O = win(orders, "order_time")
dial = O[O.order_type == "dialysis_order"].admission_id.unique()
# 진단: 현재 입원의 코드만 사용, ICD 앞 3자리 접두 일치
cur_dx = dx[dx.admission_id.isin(c.admission_id)]
n_dx = cur_dx.groupby("admission_id").size().rename("n_dx")
pref = lambda code: cur_dx[cur_dx.icd_code.str.startswith(code)].admission_id.unique()

c = c.join(cr, on="admission_id").join(hgb, on="admission_id").join(n_dx, on="admission_id")
c["n_dx"] = c["n_dx"].fillna(0).astype(int)
c["dialysis_ordered"] = c.admission_id.isin(dial).astype(int)
c["dx_ckd"] = c.admission_id.isin(pref("N18")).astype(int)
c["dx_chf"] = c.admission_id.isin(pref("I50")).astype(int)
c["los_h"] = (c.discharge_time - c.admit_time).dt.total_seconds() / 3600  # length_of_stay_h 열이 없어 계산
c["n_prior_adm"] = c.groupby("patient_id").cumcount()  # 같은 환자의 이전 입원 수 (사망 제외 전 기준 아님 주의)
# n_prior_adm 는 사망 입원도 포함해야 하므로 전체 입원 기준으로 다시 계산
prior = a.groupby("patient_id").cumcount().rename("n_prior_adm")
c["n_prior_adm"] = prior.loc[c.index].values

feats = [f["name"] for f in design["features"]]
# --- 분할: family_id 가 80% 비어 있어 결측이면 patient_id 로 대체 (설계 문제로 보고)
c["split_group"] = c.family_id.fillna("PAT_" + c.patient_id)
gss = GroupShuffleSplit(n_splits=1, test_size=design["split"]["test_fraction"], random_state=design["split"]["seed"])
tr, te = next(gss.split(c, groups=c.split_group))
c["split"] = "train"; c.iloc[te, c.columns.get_loc("split")] = "test"

cols = ["admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "split_group", "split", "tp", "followup_complete"] + feats + ["readmit_30d"]
c[cols].to_csv(OUT / "cohort_features.csv", index=False)

# --- 요약
s = {
    "n_admissions": int(len(a)), "n_cohort": int(len(c)), "n_patients": int(c.patient_id.nunique()),
    "excluded_died": int((a.discharge_status == "died").sum()),
    "prevalence": round(c.readmit_30d.mean(), 4),
    "split_sizes": c.split.value_counts().to_dict(),
    "prevalence_by_split": c.groupby("split").readmit_30d.mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "family_id_missing_rate_patients": round(p.family_id.isna().mean(), 4),
    "group_overlap_train_test": int(len(set(c[c.split=="train"].split_group) & set(c[c.split=="test"].split_group))),
    "patient_overlap_train_test": int(len(set(c[c.split=="train"].patient_id) & set(c[c.split=="test"].patient_id))),
    "missing_rate": c[feats].isna().mean().round(4)[lambda x: x > 0].to_dict(),
    "followup_incomplete": int((~c.followup_complete).sum()),
    "by_discharge_status": c.groupby("discharge_status").readmit_30d.agg(["size", "mean"]).round(4).to_dict("index"),
    "by_unit": c.groupby("unit").readmit_30d.agg(["size", "mean"]).round(4).to_dict("index"),
}
(OUT / "prep_summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(s, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
print(json.dumps(s, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
EOF
